items.name: shad-fx-dither
items.title: shad-fx: dither renderer
items.description: DitherCanvas: fills its positioned parent with a pixelated canvas that draws any effect as Bayer-dithered cells.
items.author: Piergiorgio Gonni <https://www.sekei.design>
items.docs: Pair it with any effect: `<DitherCanvas effect={fx} />`. Build the effect once (useMemo or module scope) - a new reference restarts the simulation. The ordered-dither rendering derives from dither-kit (MIT, https://github.com/Boring-Software-Inc/dither-kit). See https://github.com/sekeidesign/shad-fx/blob/main/NOTICE.md

items.title: shad-fx: fire
items.author: Piergiorgio Gonni <https://www.sekei.design>
items.docs: Runs on any renderer. Needs one to show: `npx shadcn@latest add @sekei/shad-fx-dither`, then `<DitherCanvas effect={fire()} />`.
